g.text: Parking Lot: classes, two strategies, one real race
Left: the class shape. Right: why the fix lives in the database, not a mutex.
The race: two gates, one spot
UPDATE spots SET status='OCCUPIED' WHERE id=42 AND status='FREE'
Only ONE of Gate A / Gate B affects a row -- that's the winner.
The loser sees 0 rows updated and retries against a fresh query.
A mutex in ParkingLot would not have helped -- Gate A and B are separate processes.
